content: I got a MinuteCon sticker at Boston Hackers the other night.

"Most are just stickers, but some have NFC chips hidden inside.

Scan one → follow the instructions → first 5 valid submissions get 50% off a MinuteCon ticket." -- https://infosec.exchange/@minutecon/117045818571937465
I have no idea if mine has a chip or not, but I'll bring it.
